blockers.description: Many-key render-path slowdown in Physics Paint Studio: useRotoTimelineModel.ts:77 rebuilds the entire timeline model on every currentFrame change; strip re-renders all N cells per frame; Studio view-model reconstructed per frame. Pre-existing scaling ceiling exposed by group paste multiplying key count (5-10x slowdown measured natively). Persists across Studio/project reopen (key-count-driven, not state-driven).
blockers.workaround: Phase 38.1 — decouple timeline model from currentFrame, canvas-first paint priority, deferred/batched UI updates, suspend derived UI during playback.
